job.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: original full-body mecha concept candidate for a tactical game.
The attached previous draft is REJECTED because its appearance is too close to a recognizable Gundam design. Use the image ONLY for clean KINETIC_CEL drawing quality, white/teal/ochre paint family and agile martial-arts proportions. Deliberately replace the franchise-like identity features, not merely recolor or remove a single antenna. Design ONE attractive, heroic, original community-modified competitive robot named Unlicensed One. It is an autonomous 16m full-size athlete with expressive fists and hip/shoulder mobility, no weapons or wings. Mechanical engineering plausible and confident, not a toy, mascot or bulky industrial labor robot.
HEAD: entirely new compact athletic full-face helmet, slightly angular aerodynamic crown and swept-back cheek shell, teal outer helmet with ivory side panels and a single LOW swept-back central dorsal rib flush with crown. A continuous narrow amber sensor visor inside a dark graphite recessed face opening; one continuous slit, not two humanoid eye shapes. Smooth closed integrated ivory lower face/chin guard, no mouth, vents, human nose or projecting pointed chin. Ear sensor mounts flush into helmet. Front silhouette bilateral and handsome. No V-fin, no gold brow horns, no vertical antenna spikes, no forehead jewel, no forehead crest spikes, no Gundam-style mouth or humanoid mask. Do not replace it with a round disc head or monoeye military helmet.
TORSO: replace the two gold chest vent boxes and V-shaped chest arrangement. New compact solid teal ribcage shell with a simple shallow rectangular central access panel and one small offset service latch, an ochre collar bridge under the neck and vents only along lateral ribs. Exposed graphite rotary waist and structural abdominal joint allow twist. No paired front chest intake grilles, no emblem, no bird crest.
SHOULDERS: low streamlined rounded-trapezoid shoulder shells following the deltoids, ivory with teal inset and small ochre edge, no pointed winglike pauldrons. Elbows and shoulders articulated and readable. Forearms have compact strong striking guards, graphite fully mechanical fists, no human gloves.
PELVIS/LEGS: remove the characteristic long pointed front codpiece and multi-panel skirt. Compact rotary pelvis with short lateral hip protection and open athletic movement at hip sockets. Strong calves and broad agile mechanical running boots, teal toes/ivory heels, no long pointed toes. Slightly varied modular repair panels support the community-built identity; clean structural detailing rather than grime.
Keep lean athletic silhouette, white/teal/ochre palette and confident mechanical presence. Change the head, chest, shoulders and pelvis sufficiently that this is clearly an independent machine rather than the old body with horns erased. There must be no familiar logo or copied branded helmet silhouette.
Style: confident dark pressure-varying ink, broad clean color planes, maximum two crisp hard cel-shadow steps, restrained panel lines, no photoreal PBR textures or soft rendering. Neutral energetic three-quarter standing stance, two black fists gently clenched, whole body antenna-free head to both soles fully inside generous margin, one body only. Actual transparent alpha outside silhouette, no halo, floor, shadow, backdrop, text, numbers, arrows or concept board. Portrait full body composition.
